questions.question: In God's law of jealousy, who did a husband bring his wife to if he suspected she was unfaithful?
In God's law of jealousy, what did the priest do with the curses he wrote on a scroll?

answers.text: Washed them off into the bitter water
Burned the scroll on the altar
Read them aloud to the camp

questions.question: Under God's law of jealousy, a wife who had not defiled herself would be unharmed and able to conceive children. True or false?
In God's law of jealousy, the priest says the husband will make an unfaithful wife a curse among her people. True or false?
